title: Investigation Infrastructure Audit — Board H
type: Read-Only Infrastructure Audit — No Content Modifications
authority: S204 Investigation Workbench Spec; S204 Navigation Validation (Board G); S205 Admin Readiness (Board F); S205 Challenge Workbench Requirements
purpose: Assess current-state support for Question ↔ Session ↔ Recommendation ↔ Challenge linkage. Produce future-state gap analysis versus May Admin Portal requirements.

question_identity.mechanism: QID string identity (v1). Compound-key identity spec exists (v2) but not yet populated for all 2,540 items.
question_identity.gap: QID-only identity does not support unique item resolution across rotation groups. Compound-key identity (PG-011 steps 4-5) is deferred to S206. Until populated, Question→Session linkage relies on QID string matching which has known S320-class failure modes.

question_to_session_linkage.mechanism: REVISION_HISTORY.md and DEFECT_LIBRARY.md contain session references but they are free-text narrative, not structured machine-readable references.
question_to_session_linkage.gap: Cannot programmatically answer 'Which sessions touched QID P1E-C-054?' without parsing narrative text. No QID→Session index exists.

session_to_recommendation_linkage.mechanism: S202.1 Recommendation Integration model defines REC-ID format and 5-state transition model. S322 recommendation_registry.js is operational but contains no production data.
session_to_recommendation_linkage.gap: No structured Recommendation Registry exists with production entries. Recommendations live in narrative session reports and DEFECT_LIBRARY.md, not in a queryable registry.

recommendation_to_challenge_linkage.mechanism: May Administration Portal 'Challenge Workbench' is a future feature. Requirements defined in S205 (7 IQ queries, 5 escalation paths). Not yet implemented.
recommendation_to_challenge_linkage.gap: No Challenge entity exists. No workbench. May Admin Portal is at placeholder status (per S350 Admin Metrics Framework Board J).

challenge_back_to_question.mechanism: S205 Challenge Workbench defines the workflow: learner flags question → admin reviews → challenge resolved/rejected → question updated in registry. Not yet operational.
challenge_back_to_question.gap: Full challenge lifecycle requires the Admin Portal to be operational.

nine_investigation_queries.source: S204 Investigation Workbench Spec §IQ-001 through IQ-009

IQ-001_find_defects_by_qid.description: For a given QID, return all known defects and their status.
IQ-001_find_defects_by_qid.current_state: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — grep DEFECT_LIBRARY.md for QID mentions. Manual. Not queryable.
IQ-001_find_defects_by_qid.v2_target: Programmatic — query perItemResults in scan artifact + DEFECT_LIBRARY.md defect inventory.

IQ-002_find_sessions_by_qid.description: For a given QID, return all sessions that reviewed or modified it.
IQ-002_find_sessions_by_qid.current_state: NOT_SUPPORTED — no QID→Session index exists. Must parse REVISION_HISTORY.md narrative text.
IQ-002_find_sessions_by_qid.v2_target: Programmatic — query RecommendationRegistry and session_registry.json by compound key.

IQ-003_find_recommendations_by_session.description: For a given session, return all recommendations generated.
IQ-003_find_recommendations_by_session.current_state: NOT_SUPPORTED — recommendations exist only in narrative session reports.
IQ-003_find_recommendations_by_session.v2_target: Programmatic — query RecommendationRegistry by sourceSession field.

IQ-004_trace_item_certification_path.description: Trace an item from Unprocessed through All Gates to Certified.
IQ-004_trace_item_certification_path.current_state: NOT_SUPPORTED — no per-item gate history exists. question_state is a single field with no transition log.
IQ-004_trace_item_certification_path.v2_target: Programmatic — query scan artifact lineage + delta ledger content_hash history.

IQ-005_find_unresolved_recs_by_domain.description: Find all open recommendations for a blueprint domain.
IQ-005_find_unresolved_recs_by_domain.current_state: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — DEFECT_LIBRARY.md entries grouped by defect, not domain. Manual cross-reference required.
IQ-005_find_unresolved_recs_by_domain.v2_target: Programmatic — RecommendationRegistry filtered by section/domain metadata from scan artifact.

IQ-006_find_duplicate_reviews.description: Find items that were reviewed multiple times without change.
IQ-006_find_duplicate_reviews.current_state: NOT_SUPPORTED — no delta review data exists yet.
IQ-006_find_duplicate_reviews.v2_target: Programmatic — delta ledger UNCHANGED classification + agent utilization tracking.

IQ-007_find_certified_items_with_defects.description: Find all Certified items where a defect was subsequently discovered.
IQ-007_find_certified_items_with_defects.current_state: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — S350/S351 Board E analysis manually identifies 154 Certified items with known defects. Not queryable.
IQ-007_find_certified_items_with_defects.v2_target: Programmatic — cross-reference scan artifact perItemResults[questionState=CERTIFIED] ∩ defectInventory.byDefect.

assessment.ESC-001_learner_flags_item: NOT_BUILT — requires May Coaching Layer challenge button + Admin Portal queue.
assessment.ESC-002_admin_reviews_challenge: NOT_BUILT — requires Admin Portal Challenge Workbench + Registry lookup.
assessment.ESC-003_reviewer_assigned: NOT_BUILT — requires RBAC (specified in S204, not operational).
assessment.ESC-004_finding_remediation: NOT_BUILT — remediation assignment defined in S202.1 but not integrated with Challenge flow.
assessment.ESC-005_closed_and_attested: NOT_BUILT — closure attestation requires full challenge lifecycle.

may_admin_portal_requirements.source: S204 Admin Pilot Results (Board H); S205 Admin Readiness (Board F)
may_admin_portal_requirements.portal_status: PLACEHOLDER — per S350 Admin Metrics Framework Board J: 'Forward-looking admin platform metrics. Portal not yet operational.'

gap_1_canonical_registry.description: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json — single source of truth for every question's identity, content hash, certification status, and defect history. Not yet seeded.
gap_1_canonical_registry.impact: Without the registry, no Admin Portal module can perform QID-based lookups. This is the foundational dependency.
gap_1_canonical_registry.estimated_resolution: S206 T0 — seed CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json from S322 scan artifact perItemResults.

gap_2_recommendation_registry_historical.description: RecommendationRegistry exists as infrastructure but contains no entries. Historical recommendations from DEFECT_LIBRARY.md and REVISION_HISTORY.md have not been back-populated.
gap_2_recommendation_registry_historical.impact: IQ-003, IQ-005, and the full traceability chain require populated recommendations.
gap_2_recommendation_registry_historical.estimated_resolution: Post-S207 — historical back-population is a one-time effort.

gap_3_session_registry_historical_popula.description: session_registry.json (S322 infrastructure) captures new sessions. Historical sessions (S1 through S321) have no structured entries.
gap_3_session_registry_historical_popula.impact: IQ-002 (find sessions by QID) cannot cover pre-S322 history without back-population.
gap_3_session_registry_historical_popula.estimated_resolution: Post-S207 — historical back-population. Optional for Phase 1.

gap_4_admin_portal_implementation.description: May Administration Portal is a future development project. 7 modules, 5 roles, 16 security enforcement points are specified but not built.
gap_4_admin_portal_implementation.impact: All Challenge+Investigation workflows (IQ-001 through IQ-007, ESC-001 through ESC-005) are blocked until the portal is operational.
gap_4_admin_portal_implementation.estimated_resolution: May-focused development track. Not a 350-Series deliverable. Earliest: post-S910 (Legacy Retirement).

gap_5_per_item_gate_history.description: No per-item gate transition history exists. question_state is a single field with no audit trail of state transitions.
gap_5_per_item_gate_history.impact: IQ-004 (trace certification path) cannot be answered without gate history.
gap_5_per_item_gate_history.estimated_resolution: Per-item gate history must be added to scan artifact schema v2.0.0. Deferred.

future_state_gap_analysis.critical_path: CANONICAL_REGISTRY.json seeding (S206) → Recommendation + Session registry population (post-S207) → Admin Portal build (May track). Blocked until the registry and portal are operational.

verdict: INVESTIGATION_INFRASTRUCTURE_SPECIFIED — The S202.1 Investigation Linkage model (7 IQ queries, 5 escalation paths) provides a comprehensive specification. The underlying data infrastructure (CANONICAL_REGISTRY, RecommendationRegistry, session_registry) exists in S322 but is unpopulated. The May Admin Portal (required for Challenge workflows) is at placeholder status. Investigation infrastructure is architecturally sound but not yet operational for production use.
